explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/552: is it true that for any c > 0 there are infinitely many n with R(C₄, S_n) ≤ n + √n − c, where S_n = K_{1,n}? The statement uses graphRamsey (cycleGraph 4) (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin 1) (Fin n)) and asks, for every c > 0, for an infinite set of such n. Faithful.
